Dallas Detox Center Offers Addiction Treatment near Farmers Branch, TX

blocks.html:
Dallas Detox Center is a Farmers Branch drug and alcohol rehab center in Weatherford, Tx, that offers detoxification and inpatient treatment programming. We recognize the chaos that active addiction can create in your life, which is why we individualize our addiction treatment program. Each individual who walks through our doors has different needs when it comes to their treatment. Our holistic treatment approach works to provide you with the support you need in all the areas of your life that were impacted by your addiction.

In our luxurious treatment facility, your treatment program will include a combination of educational sessions, group therapy, and individual therapy sessions. If you are living with another mental health concern, such as depression, anxiety, and trauma, you may need dual diagnosis treatment. Depending on your individual treatment plan, your program can last from 30 to 90 days.

A unique aspect of the treatment we provide at Dallas Detox Center is that we offer Alumni Services. This includes check-in calls or visits to ensure that you are doing well in your recovery. If there comes a time in the future when you would benefit from returning to our inpatient program, we can help you navigate readmission.
